import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_right p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzag (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)
  | _ => t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzag_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild, originally P's right child) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_right (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma zigzag_preserves_bst
    (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree)
    (h :
      is_bst
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
            (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d)) :
    is_bst
      (BinarySearchTree.Node x
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) := by
  simp only [is_bst] at h ⊢
  rcases h with ⟨hPg, hP, hDg, hD⟩
  rcases hP with ⟨hAp, hA, hXp, hX⟩
  rcases hX with ⟨hBx, hB, hCx, hC⟩

  have hpx : p < x := by
    apply hXp x
    simp [view]

  have hxg : x < g := by
    apply hPg x
    simp [view]

  have hBp : ∀ y ∈ view b, y > p := by
    intro y hy
    apply hXp y
    simp [view, hy]

  have hCg : ∀ y ∈ view c, y < g := by
    intro y hy
    apply hPg y
    simp [view, hy]

  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with hab | hyp
    · rcases hab with ha | hb
      · exact lt_trans (hAp y ha) hpx
      · exact hBx y hb
    · subst y
      exact hpx
  · exact ⟨hAp, hA, hBp, hB⟩
  · intro y hy
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    rcases hy with hcd | hyg
    · rcases hcd with hc | hd
      · exact hCx y hc
      · exact lt_trans hxg (hDg y hd)
    · subst y
      exact hxg
  · exact ⟨hCg, hC, hDg, hD⟩

lemma zigzag_preserves_view
    (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree) :
    view
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
          (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) =
      view
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
            (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) := by
  ext y
  simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzag_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) :
    zigzag_postcond t (zigzag t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
  | Node g l d =>
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node,
            get_left, get_right] at h_precond
      | Node p a r =>
          cases r with
          | Empty =>
              simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node,
                get_left, get_right] at h_precond
          | Node x b c =>
              have hbst :
                  is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) :=
                h_precond.1
              change
                is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node x
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) ∧
                  view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node x
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) =
                    view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
                          (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) ∧
                  some x = some x
              exact
                ⟨zigzag_preserves_bst g p x a b c d hbst,
                  zigzag_preserves_view g p x a b c d,
                  rfl⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof

  · exact ⟨hCg, hC, hDg, hD⟩

lemma zigzag_preserves_view
    (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree) :
    view
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
          (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) =
      view
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
            (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) := by
  ext y
  simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzag_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) :
    zigzag_postcond t (zigzag t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
  | Node g l d =>
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node,
            get_left, get_right] at h_precond
      | Node p a r =>
          cases r with
          | Empty =>
              simp [zigzag_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node,
                get_left, get_right] at h_precond
          | Node x b c =>
              have hbst :
                  is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) :=
                h_precond.1
              change
                is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node x
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) ∧
                  view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node x
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a b)
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d)) =
                    view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p a
                          (BinarySearchTree.Node x b c)) d) ∧
                  some x = some x
              exact
                ⟨zigzag_preserves_bst g p x a b c d hbst,
                  zigzag_preserves_view g p x a b c d,
                  rfl⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
